rows.question: What is photometrically observed star
rows.pred_sql:
WITH star_photo_types AS (
  SELECT value
  FROM photo_type
  WHERE (name ILIKE '%STAR%' OR description ILIKE '%star%')
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.type,
  p.mode,
  p.clean,
  p.extinction_r
FROM photoobj p
JOIN star_photo_types spt
  ON p.type = spt.value
WHERE
  p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  AND p.clean IS NOT NULL
  AND p.clean <> 0
  AND p.r IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.r ASC

rows.question: What is photometrically observed Galaxy
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photoobj_basic_23 AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid::bigint AS objid,
    p.run::smallint AS run,
    p.rerun::smallint AS rerun,
    p.field::smallint AS field,
    p.mode::smallint AS mode,
    p.type::smallint AS type,
    p.clean::integer AS clean,
    p.ra::double precision AS ra,
    p.dec::double precision AS dec,
    p.u::real AS u,
    p.g::real AS g,
    p.r::real AS r,
    p.i::real AS i,
    p.z::real AS z
  FROM photoobj p
),
specobj_basic AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    s.bestobjid,
    s.class,
    s.subclass,
    s.z,
    s.zerr
  FROM specobj s
  WHERE s.specobjid IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      s.class ILIKE '%galaxy%'
      OR s.class = 'GALAXY'
      OR s.class = 'gal'
    )
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  s.specobjid,
  s.class,
  s.subclass,
  s.z AS spec_z,
  s.zerr
FROM specobj_basic s
JOIN galspecline g ON s.specobjid = g.specobjid
JOIN photoobj_basic_23 p ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
WHERE p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND s.specobjid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.objid ASC

  -- gather specobj <-> photoobj matches, keep spec id and photo objid
  SELECT s.specobjid, COALESCE(s.bestobjid, s.specobjid) AS objid

  WHERE s.specobjid IS NOT NULL
)

FROM photoobj p
